sources.snippet: Configuration: Qwen3Config Qwen3Config is a @dataclass in qwen3/config.py 15-52 that holds all hyperparameters for a Qwen3 model variant. It is constructed from a HuggingFace config.json via the from_model_dir class method, which reads the JSON and maps field names to the internal naming convention.

sources.title: An adaptable JSON Diff Framework
sources.snippet: In this paper, we present an implementation of JSON-diff framework JYCM, extending the existing framework by introducing the concept of "unordered" comparisons and allowing users to customize their comparison scenarios flexibly. Furthermore, we provide a diff-result renderer to visualize better and understand the differences between JSON objects. Our work enables more adaptable and comprehensive comparisons to accommodate a wider range of use cases and requirements.
